families.title: Fresh
families.blurb: The family of citrus, green leaves and clean air. Usually the lightest to wear.

families.title: Floral
families.blurb: The family of flowers, from a single soft petal to a full bouquet.

families.title: Woody
families.blurb: The family of woods and dry, quiet materials. Often the longest lasting.

families.title: Warm
families.blurb: The family of resins, ambers and sweeter notes. Close to the skin, often for evenings.
